author: priya
text: Heads up: Atlas is blocked by a security finding found this morning. No beta until it's fixed and retested. More when I know more.

author: maya
text: Ok. I'll let design partners know we're aiming for later this week instead of Wednesday, no details.

author: priya
text: Update: the security finding is fixed and retested (thanks Alex, Jordan). The remaining security items are GA-only. Beta is back on track pending PR #219 and my go/no-go.

author: jasmine
text: Launch comms question: I'd love to send the 'Introducing Atlas' email to all customers Monday and post the blog. Is that ok if beta goes out Friday?

author: maya
text: Hmm, beta is only Northwind, Lumen and Kestrel. Wouldn't a blast to everyone create a ton of 'how do I get it' tickets?

author: jasmine
text: Fair. I'll draft both versions and ask Priya.

author: maya
text:
Design partner readiness:
• Northwind: 14 users, ready, agreement signed
• Kestrel: 22 users, ready, agreement signed
• Lumen: 8 users, ready, but DPA countersignature pending (expected Monday)
All three accepted beta limits: no enterprise SSO, 30-day date ranges, reversible rollout.

author: fatima
text: Beta release checklist (ATLAS-30): 7/9 done. Open: PR #219 merged, Priya's go/no-go.
